text:
This YouTube Short was made without opening any editing app.

I write 8 lines in a text file.
A free GitHub workflow turns it into:
→ 1080×1920 video
→ Hindi voice-over
→ captions + music
→ one of 7 designs so videos don't look the same
→ uploaded and scheduled on YouTube, Instagram, Facebook

45+ videos so far. Software bill: ₹0.

Businesses spend ₹15-30k a month on editors for this.
Most of it can be automated.
